the proposed system, ConvSRC, is an efficient, compact, robust and simple periocular recognition technique which outperforms the state of the arts.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects of periocular recognition: 1) The use of CNN for periocular recognition, 2) the development of an effective feature extraction technique based on the activations of convolutional layers of CNN and 3) the use of SA CRC for recognition.

the following: 1) The development of an efficient image representation method that takes into account both the sparsity and the discriminative power of the CNN activations. 2) The development of a robust recognition technique that is able to deal with the intra class variability of the periocular data.
the following: (i) We propose an efficient periocular image representation technique that exploits the discriminative information in the activations of convolutional layers of a pre-trained VGG Net.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is simple and efficient and can be used in real life applications like smart phones.
ConvSRC outperforms all existing methods in the literature for periocular recognition.

the proposed system ConvSRC outperforms the state of the-art techniques in periocular recognition and can be used as an effective tool for the periocular based smartphone based biometric applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ConvSRC is the first method to achieve 99% GMR at FMR 1000 on VISOB database.
we have shown that the proposed ConvSRC is an efficient and robust method for periocular recognition and it is capable of handling the challenges of the periocular recognition task.

we have proposed a novel image representation technique based on deep learning and collaborative representation which is robust to the variations of the periocular images and can be applied on the images captured from a smartphone.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed ConvSRC system can achieve state of the art performance on periocular images without any fine-tuning of the CNN model.
ConvSRC can be used for periocular recognition using the activations of a pertained CNN and it can be used for other image classification tasks using activations from different layers.
, ConvSRC achieves superior results using a simple, efficient image representation technique and an effective classification method.
